updates.title_zh: Kraken母公司Payward探索海外设立全能银行
updates.title_en: Kraken parent Payward explores becoming full bank outside US
updates.what_changed_zh: Kraken母公司Payward探索海外设立全能银行
updates.what_changed_en: Kraken parent Payward explores becoming full bank outside US
updates.current_state_zh: Kraken母公司Payward探索海外设立全能银行
updates.current_state_en: Kraken parent Payward explores becoming full bank outside US
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 加密货币交易所Kraken的母公司Payward正在探索在海外成为一家全能银行，业务范围将扩展至银行、贷款和资产管理，未来还可能涉及抵押贷款。 此举标志着加密货币行业进一步机构化，主要参与者正进军传统金融服务领域。这也可能为其他寻求在海外获得银行牌照的加密公司开创先例，模糊加密货币与传统银行之间的界限。 目前该探索仍处于战略阶段，尚未获得监管最终批准，也不会产生直接影响。该银行将在美国以外运营，但具体司法管辖区尚未披露。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, is exploring becoming a full bank outside the US, expanding into banking, lending, and asset management, with mortgages a future possibility. This move signals further institutionalization of the crypto industry as major players push into traditional financial services. It could also set a precedent for other crypto firms seeking banking licenses abroad, blurring the line between crypto and conventional banking. The exploration is at a strategic stage, with no regulatory finality or immediate market impact. The bank would operate outside the US, though specific jurisdictions have not been disclosed.

updates.title_zh: Payward 以 20 亿美元收购攻势扩张 Kraken - Crypto News
updates.title_en: Payward expands Kraken with $2B acquisition push - Crypto News
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 Crypto News 报道，加密货币交易所 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 正在推进一项以约 20 亿美元收购为核心的扩张战略，目标是扩大该交易所的业务版图。

Payward 联合首席执行官 Arjun Sethi 曾表示，公司正在把交易、支付、资产管理与机构服务整合到共同的基础设施之上；此次报道的收购攻势，正属于这一“不止于加密货币交易所”的既定方向。

这一收购计划的主体是 Kraken 的母公司 Payward，而非 Kraken 交易所本身。
updates.what_changed_en: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, is advancing an expansion strategy anchored by roughly $2B in acquisitions to grow the exchange's business.

updates.background_zh: Kraken 于 2011 年 7 月联合创立，母公司为 Payward，其法定名称即 Payward, Inc.。截至 2025 年，Kraken 的季度交易量达 2070 亿美元，在全球加密货币交易所中排名第十四；在美国大多数州，它还提供股票、期货和 ETF 的交易服务。Payward 自我定位为 Kraken 及一系列业务的母公司，业务覆盖交易、托管、支付、借贷、链上金融和基准指数。
updates.background_en: Kraken was co-founded in July 2011 with Payward as its parent company, and is legally named Payward, Inc. By 2025 it reported $207 billion in quarterly trading volume and was ranked the world's fourteenth-largest crypto exchange; in most US states it also facilitates trading of stocks, futures and ETFs. Payward describes itself as the parent behind Kraken and a portfolio of businesses spanning trading, custody, payments, lending, onchain finance and benchmarks.
updates.market_impact_zh: 交易所并购消息对加密市场的影响主要通过市场结构传导：流动性集中在哪些交易场所、客户流量流向何处，以及托管与机构服务如何打包。一家全球前二十大交易所提出约 20 亿美元的收购计划，影响的是现货与衍生品平台之间的竞争格局，而非直接作用于某一具体代币。
updates.market_impact_en: Exchange consolidation news transmits to crypto markets mainly through market structure: which venues hold liquidity and client flow, and how custody and institutional servicing are packaged. A roughly $2 billion acquisition programme at a top-20 exchange bears on competitive positioning among spot and derivatives platforms rather than on any single token directly.

updates.title_zh: 加密货币交易所 Kraken 母公司拟收购一家欧洲银行
updates.title_en: Crypto exchange Kraken owner to buy European bank
updates.what_changed_zh: Payward同意收购立陶宛的Saldo Bank，以获得欧盟银行牌照，交易需监管批准，预计2027年完成。
updates.what_changed_en: Payward agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank for an undisclosed amount, securing an EU banking license, subject to regulatory approval and expected to close in 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: Payward已同意收购Saldo Bank以获得欧盟银行牌照，交易待监管批准，预计2027年完成。
updates.current_state_en: Payward has agreed to acquire Saldo Bank to obtain an EU banking license, pending regulatory approval, expected to close in 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
加密货币交易所 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 已达成协议，将以未披露的金额收购总部位于立陶宛的 Saldo Bank，这笔交易将使其获得欧盟银行牌照。该收购仍需监管批准，预计于 2027 年完成。

据《金融时报》报道，该交易将使 Payward 能够为欧盟客户提供计息存款、贷款、银行卡服务和欧元支付，从而把业务从加密货币交易扩展到传统金融服务，并使其成为首家收购欧洲银行的加密公司。

截至 2025 年底，Saldo Bank 的总资产为 1.639 亿欧元（约 1.8 亿美元），同比增长 22.7%；该行在立陶宛、芬兰、瑞典和德国持有牌照，并拥有在荷兰运营的通行证，提供存款、个人及企业贷款和支付服务。Payward 表示，其银行业务已发放超过 20 亿美元贷款，并持有美联储有限用途主账户以及爱尔兰的电子货币机构牌照。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank for an undisclosed amount, a deal that would give it a European Union banking license. The acquisition is subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close in 2027.

The deal would let Payward offer EU customers interest-bearing deposits, loans, card services and euro payments, expanding it beyond crypto trading, and would make it the first crypto firm to buy a European bank, according to the Financial Times.

Saldo Bank had €163.9 million (about $180 million) in total assets at the end of 2025, up 22.7% year over year, and is licensed in Lithuania, Finland, Sweden and Germany with a passport to operate in the Netherlands; it offers deposits, consumer and business loans and payment services. Payward said its banking business has already originated more than $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an electronic money institution license in Ireland.
updates.background_zh: Kraken 是一家成立于 2011 年的美国加密货币交易所，据维基百科介绍，它是首家获得银行牌照的加密公司。Payward 一直在推进受监管金融基础设施布局：它已申请美国的 national trust bank 牌照，CoinDesk 在 7 月报道称 Kraken 正在争取立陶宛的银行牌照。Payward 联合首席执行官 Arjun Sethi 表示，一家受监管的欧盟银行“让我们能够像主要金融机构那样服务欧洲客户：一个可以持有资产、自由转移资产并让资产产生收益的地方”。
updates.background_en: Kraken is a US-based cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2011, and per Wikipedia it was the first crypto company to obtain a bank charter. Payward has been pushing into regulated financial infrastructure: it has applied for a US national trust bank charter, and CoinDesk reported in July that Kraken was seeking a banking license in Lithuania. Payward co-CEO Arjun Sethi said a regulated EU bank "is the piece that lets us serve European clients the way a primary financial institution should: one place to hold assets, move them freely, and put them to work."
updates.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易把加密行业的资金直接引入受欧盟监管的银行基础设施，使 Payward 掌握吸收存款、放贷和欧元支付通道，与面向欧盟加密用户的传统银行形成竞争。主要影响传导至面向欧盟市场的交易所、托管与支付服务商——其法币出入金和收益类产品将面对一家持牌银行的竞争；同时该交易预计 2027 年完成，并仍待监管批准。
updates.market_impact_en: The transaction channels crypto-native capital directly into EU-regulated banking infrastructure, giving Payward control of deposit-taking, lending and euro payment rails that compete with traditional lenders serving EU crypto users. The main exposure runs through EU-facing exchanges, custody and payments providers whose fiat on/off-ramp and yield products would face a licensed banking competitor, with the deal's 2027 closing and regulatory approval still pending.
